verdicts.reason: Both shrink the yellow date card (SAT 22 NOV, 8 PM–1 AM) to an illegible postage stamp, which loses key event information. Both also turn the bottom pattern strip into an arbitrary right-hand block and put the CTA left of and before the headline. A at least keeps the body copy under the headline with a readable controller icon. B scatters the eyebrow, tiny date card, CTA and wrapped body copy down a ragged left column, and shrinks the controller to a speck, so its reading order is worse.
